# awx_generic_endpoint (Resource)

WARNING: This resource is still in development and not tested for all API endpoints. It can be used as a catch-all for endpoints that do not have a dedicated resource yet. Use at your own risk.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awx_generic_endpoint" "test-credential-type" {
  api_path     = "credential_types"
  api_endpoint = "controller"
  data_json = jsonencode(
    {
      "description" : "",
      "injectors" : {},
      "inputs" : { "fields" : [] },
      "kind" : "cloud",
      "name" : "test-credential-type"
    }
  )
  ignore_read = ["created", "created_by", "id", "managed", "modified", "modified_by", "namespace", "related", "summary_fields", "type", "url"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_endpoint` (String) API endpoint for the GenericEndpoint. Must be `controller`, as all AWX/AAP2.4 endpoints are served from /api/v2/.
- `api_path` (String) API path for the GenericEndpoint, relative to the API endpoint. For example, if the URL is /api/controller/v2/credential_types/ (or /api/v2/credential_types/ in AWX), the api_path is `credential_types`.

### Optional

- `data_json` (String) Data in `jsonencode()` format to send to the API endpoint.
- `disable_delete` (Boolean) Set this to true if the api endpoint is not able to delete the data or if the endpoint does not support the DELETE method. Setting this to true will prevent Terraform from attempting to delete the resource.
- `disable_read` (Boolean) Set this to true if the api endpoint is not able to read the data or if the endpoint does not support the GET method. Setting this to true will break drift detection. You should set this to true for endpoints that are write-only. Defaults to false.
- `ignore_read` (Set of String) List of attribute names to ignore during the read operation. This can be used to prevent drift detection on attributes that are dynamically created with the resource.
- `update_method` (String) HTTP method to use for updates. Defaults to `put`. Can be one of `put` or `patch`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GenericEndpoint ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

# IMPORT NOT SUPPORTED
